newsitem.title: USA: Star Technologies holds merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Star Technologies holds merger talks.

text.p: Star Technologies Inc said Monday it is holding merger talks with an unnamed imaging company.

"Star is currently engaged in discussions with an imaging company relating to the possible acquisition of that company's technology and certain other assets," a statement said, adding Star had not reached a formal agreement.
Star said it has been working with several investment banking firms over the past two years to identify potential merger and acquisition partners.
Star said last October it had ended merger discussions with Electronic Instrumentation and Technology Co.

The company reported a net loss of $696,00, or $0.04 a share, for the quarter ended March 31, compared with a net loss of $1.5 million, or $0.09 a share, the year before. Its stock traded unchanged at 1/4 Monday afternoon.
